info.description: Food Manufacturing Inventory System REST API.
info.title: FMIS API

post.description: Verifies credentials by username or email and returns a token pair.
Revokes a refresh token, ending the session. The access token itself remains valid until it expires.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile (id, username, email, role).

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token + refresh token pair.
Creates a user with the default VIEWER role and returns a token pair. Requires a unique username and email.
Registers an incoming lot of a product. ADMIN or OPERATOR role required.

422.description: Expiration date required for this product

get.description: Returns all non-depleted, non-quarantined batches for a product, ordered FEFO (soonest expiration first).
get.summary: List active batches for a product

patch.description: Marks an ACTIVE batch as QUARANTINED so it is excluded from FEFO consumption. ADMIN or OPERATOR role required.

post.description: Records a WASTE or ADJUSTMENT stock movement on a single batch. ADMIN or OPERATOR role required.
Deducts stock across batches of a product, oldest expiration first (FEFO). ADMIN or OPERATOR role required.

get.description: Returns the immutable audit trail of stock movements, optionally filtered.

parameters.description: Filter by type (INCOMING, OUTGOING, USED_IN_PRODUCTION, WASTE, ADJUSTMENT)
parameters.name: transaction_type

parameters.description: Only transactions created at or after this RFC3339 timestamp
parameters.name: date_from

parameters.description: Only transactions created at or before this RFC3339 timestamp
parameters.name: date_to

get.description: Lists production orders, optionally filtered by status and paginated.

parameters.description: Filter by status (PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED)
parameters.name: status

post.description: Creates a PLANNED production order: validates the output product and input batches, reserves the output batch, and inserts the order with its line items in one transaction. ADMIN or OPERATOR role required.

get.description: Retrieves a single production order with its line items.

post.description: Cancels a PLANNED or IN_PROGRESS order. No inventory impact. ADMIN role required.

409.description: Order not in PLANNED or IN_PROGRESS state

post.description: Atomically deducts input batch quantities, finalizes the output batch, and links all transactions to the order. ADMIN or OPERATOR role required.
Transitions a PLANNED order to IN_PROGRESS. The order row is locked to prevent concurrent starts. ADMIN or OPERATOR role required.

get.description: Lists catalog products, optionally filtered by product type and paginated.

parameters.description: Filter by type (RAW_MATERIAL, PACKAGING, FINISHED_GOOD, WHITE_LABEL)
parameters.name: product_type

post.description: Adds a new catalog item. ADMIN or OPERATOR role required.

get.description: Retrieves a single catalog product by UUID.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a catalog product. ADMIN role required. Fails if the product still has active batches.

patch.description: Partially updates a catalog product. ADMIN role required.

BearerAuth.description: Pass the JWT access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
